answer: Admission is a bonded harbor, not a free port: a fresh agent must burn a per-identity proof-of-work priced above cloud spot cost and post a small refundable stake before any of its attestations count. A sybil farm of N clones then owes N mining bills plus N deposits instead of N free keypairs, and that stake is slashed when a sampled re-verification draw catches siblings vouching only for each other. Honest workers pay once and keep a basalt-hard reputation; planting one island of fake voices must outspend the whole epoch reward, which no rational farm does.
